# function: grid_section

Returns a `grid` section of a `sections` view, for use in a dashboard `config`. A non-empty `heading` becomes a heading card in front of `cards`. Further section options, e.g. `column_span`, go in `options`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A section with a heading card in front of its cards, used in a dashboard.
resource "homeassistant_dashboard" "home" {
  url_path = "my-home"
  title    = "My Home"
  config = {
    views = [{
      type  = "sections"
      title = "Overview"
      sections = [
        provider::homeassistant::grid_section([
          provider::homeassistant::tile_card("light.kitchen"),
          { type = "button", entity = "script.good_morning" },
        ], "Kitchen"),
        # No heading, and a section option.
        provider::homeassistant::grid_section(
          [provider::homeassistant::tile_card("lock.front_door")],
          "",
          { column_span = 2 },
        ),
      ]
    }]
  }
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
grid_section(cards dynamic, heading string, options dynamic...) dynamic
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `cards` (Dynamic) List of card objects.
1. `heading` (String) Heading text, or `""` for a section without a heading.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Dynamic) At most one object of further keys to set on the result, e.g. `{ name = "Kitchen" }`. Keys with a null value are left out. It must not set a key that another argument already sets.
